title: Class-group source and license provenance
objective: Complete production-source provenance mappings and distribution notice/source-obligation documentation for the Rust cubic class-group package without asserting unreviewed legal conclusions

oracles: Cargo lock and native link dependency closure

handoff.summary: Completed function-level PARI 2.17.4 correspondence for all seven formerly partial behavioral production modules, explicitly separating mapped behavior from Sage.js-owned representation, proof, resource, and standard-arithmetic helpers. Corrected the stale root Cargo package identity and removed an unsupported combined-distribution licensing conclusion while preserving legal_conclusion=false. Added a package NOTICE and focused LICENSES review bundle covering PARI, the locked Rust registry closure, rug/gmp-mpfr-sys, GMP, MPFR, FLINT with integrated Arb, OpenBLAS, corresponding-source assembly, and target-specific static-LGPL relinking materials.
risks: No human lawyer or designated release reviewer has approved license compatibility, notice sufficiency, corresponding-source scope, or a relink mechanism; the manifest deliberately retains legal_conclusion=false.
No native, Windows, or Wasm release artifact has an artifact-derived SBOM proving which Cargo/native copies were actually linked or whether duplicate GMP/MPFR runtimes are present.
The notice bundle is a review draft and points release assembly to upstream complete license/notice files; it is not itself a complete release source or license bundle.
pnpm test:changed passed merge and architecture checks but the inherited full build failed on unrelated numerical Wasm production-manifest toolchain drift.
pnpm test:portable passed 204 files before stopping on unrelated pre-existing modular q-expansion source-freeze drift in architecture/package-graph.json.
next_steps: Have a human/legal reviewer approve or correct the package and combined-artifact license analysis without changing legal_conclusion until that review is recorded.
Generate an artifact-derived SBOM for each native, Windows, and Wasm artifact and reconcile it with Cargo.lock, native build receipts, and the prospective foreign-dependency routes.

Assemble and independently test the complete corresponding-source bundle and an artifact-specific LGPL relink procedure, including object files, archives, scripts, flags, sysroots, linker inputs, and installation information.
Resolve the integration branch's unrelated numerical toolchain and modular q-expansion freeze drift, then rerun pnpm test:changed and portable release validation.
